payload.final_answer: To find the poem and the book, I will first identify poetry collections published between 2010 and 2020 that are the fourth by their authors and have won awards from independent literary presses. I will also look for collections that have titles in a language other than English and check if they have a last line with two identical words that match the book's title. Additionally, I will research authors born in the mid-1900s with PhDs in folklore who may have nominated these works for awards.
